title: SystemStatus
description: SAIA-Class S runtime status schema describing the current operational state, module health, performance metrics, and active envelopes for Beast System 3.0.

systemId.description: Unique identifier of the running system instance.

version.description: Current running version of the Beast System.

uptimeSeconds.description: Total uptime of the system in seconds.

operationalState.description: Current operational state of the system.

moduleStatus.description: Health and activity status of each core module.
